title: File:UTMB 2005 check point.jpg
claims: The file description states that the photo shows a checkpoint on the Ultra Trail Tour du Mont Blanc 2005.
The photo shows a mountain checkpoint with a yellow trailer and red-and-white course tape.
The file is licensed CC BY 2.5 and credited as own work by the original uploader.
The file page does not name the pass or kilometre where the checkpoint sits.
